system.description:
• Effect: During a full rest, brew draughts in your cauldron (a pot, kettle or skull will do). You brew 2 draughts at 1st level, 3 at 5th, 4 at 9th, 5 at 13th and 6 at 17th.
  • A draught keeps its power until your next full rest.
  • Drinking a draught, or pouring it into a willing or helpless creature, is part of an action. A splash brew is thrown up to 20ft instead, as part of an action.
  • You know 4 recipes at 1st level, and learn 2 more at 5th, 9th, 13th and 17th (see Cauldron Recipes).
  • Each recipe improves at 5th, 9th, 13th and 17th. Each tier adds to the one before unless it says otherwise.

activities.name: Witch Bottle
activities.text: {1:Advantage on saves of one kind (Fortitude, Reflex or Will, the drinker's choice) for an hour., 5:Advantage on saves of one kind for an hour; also ends lesser curses and one disease., 9:Advantage on all three saves for an hour, and temporary HP equal to your Witch level + Wisdom modifier; also ends lesser curses and one disease., 13:Advantage on all three saves, and can't be Frightened or Charmed, for an hour; temporary HP equal to your Witch level + Wisdom modifier; ends lesser curses and one disease., 17:Advantage on all three saves, and can't be Frightened or Charmed, for an hour; temporary HP equal to twice your Witch level + Wisdom modifier; ends any curse and one disease.}

activities.name: Seer's Draught
activities.text: {1:An omen about a place or person., 5:An omen and one yes-or-no answer., 9:An omen, one yes-or-no answer and a short vision., 13:An omen, a vision, and one question answered truthfully in a sentence., 17:An omen, a vision and one question answered truthfully; also can't be surprised for a day.}

activities.name: Threshold Salt
activities.text: {1:Poured on a doorway: you know when anything crosses it., 5:Poured on a doorway: you know when anything crosses it, and hostile spirits and fey can't cross., 9:Covers a whole building: you know when anything crosses, and hostile spirits and fey can't cross., 13:Covers a whole building: you know when anything crosses, and hostile spirits, fey, undead and fiends can't cross., 17:Covers a castle or a village quarter: you know when anything crosses, and the kinds of creature you name can't cross.}

activities.name: Familiar's Broth
activities.text: {1:Fed to the familiar: it scouts or carries a message up to 1 mile., 5:Fed to the familiar: it scouts or carries a message up to 5 miles., 9:Fed to the familiar: it scouts or carries a message up to 20 miles, and you see through its eyes., 13:Fed to the familiar: it travels anywhere on the same plane you have been, and you see through its eyes., 17:Fed to the familiar: it travels anywhere you have been on this plane, or into the Feywild or the Shadowfell and back, and you see through its eyes.}

activities.name: Hag's Remedy
activities.text: {1:Stabilises a dying creature and ends Poisoned., 5:Stabilises a dying creature, ends Poisoned and one disease.}

activities.name: Hag's Remedy
activities.text: {9:Stabilises a dying creature, ends Poisoned and one disease, and restores this many HP., 13:Stabilises, ends Poisoned, one disease, Paralysed or Petrified, and restores this many HP., 17:Stabilises, ends Poisoned, one disease, Paralysed or Petrified, and restores this many HP; a creature that died within the last round returns at 1 HP.}

activities.name: Nightsight Tea
activities.text: {1:Darkvision 60ft for an hour., 5:Darkvision 60ft for an hour, seeing through magical darkness., 9:Darkvision 60ft for an hour, seeing through magical darkness; sees invisible creatures for one encounter., 13:Darkvision 60ft for an hour, seeing through magical darkness; Truesight 30ft for one encounter., 17:Darkvision and Truesight 60ft for an hour.}

activities.name: Hearthfire Broth
activities.text: {1:Temporary HP for an hour., 5:Temporary HP for an hour., 9:Temporary HP for an hour., 13:Temporary HP for an hour, and Resistance 5 to cold and fire., 17:Temporary HP for an hour, and immune to cold (Resistance 5 to fire).}

activities.name: Hex Oil
activities.text: {1:On a weapon, for the encounter: its first hit each round deals this extra necrotic damage., 5:On a weapon, for the encounter: its first hit each round deals this extra necrotic damage., 9:On a weapon, for the encounter: its first hit each round deals this extra necrotic damage, and the target can't regain HP until the end of its next turn., 13:On a weapon, for the encounter: its first hit each round deals this extra necrotic damage, and the target can't regain HP until the end of its next turn., 17:On a weapon, for the encounter: its first hit each round deals this extra necrotic damage, the target can't regain HP until the end of its next turn, and a creature it kills can't be raised by anything less than Wish.}

activities.name: Murk Brew
activities.text: {1:Splash: a 10ft cloud of fog (heavily obscured) for the encounter., 5:Splash: a 20ft cloud of fog for the encounter; creatures inside make a Fortitude save or are Poisoned., 9:Splash: a 20ft cloud of fog for the encounter; creatures inside make a Fortitude save or are Poisoned; you and your allies see through it., 13:Splash: a 30ft cloud for the encounter; Fortitude save or Poisoned; a Poisoned creature inside takes 2d6 poison damage at the start of its turn; you and your allies see through it., 17:Splash: a 30ft cloud for the encounter (Fortitude save or Poisoned; 2d6 poison a turn to the Poisoned inside); you and your allies see through it, and you can move it 20ft each round as part of your action.}

activities.name: Toad's Leap
activities.text: {1:Triple jump distance and no damage from falls, for an hour., 5:Triple jump distance, no damage from falls, and climb walls as if they were floors, for an hour., 9:Triple jump, no falling damage and wall-climbing for an hour; a fly speed of 30ft for 10 minutes., 13:Triple jump, no falling damage, wall-climbing and a fly speed of 60ft, for an hour., 17:Triple jump, no falling damage, wall-climbing and a fly speed of 60ft for an hour; can't be Grappled or Restrained.}

activities.name: Silver Tongue Syrup
activities.text: {1:The drinker's lies can't be detected by magic for an hour., 5:For an hour, the drinker's lies can't be detected by magic, and they speak and understand any language., 9:For an hour, undetectable lies and any language; one creature that talks with them treats them as a friend (Will negates)., 13:For an hour, undetectable lies, any language and one creature's friendship (Will negates); once, a one-sentence suggestion the creature follows (Will negates)., 17:For an hour, undetectable lies and any language; once, a one-sentence suggestion (Will negates); everyone listening for a minute treats them as a friend (Will negates).}

activities.name: Grave Dust Tea
activities.text: {1:Ask a corpse one question., 5:Ask a corpse three questions., 9:Ask a corpse three questions and see its last memory., 13:Talk with the dead for 10 minutes as if alive, and see its last memory., 17:Talk with the dead for 10 minutes and see its last memory, even if only dust or bones remain, however old.}

activities.name: Sleepwell Draught
activities.text: {1:The drinker's next rest counts as sheltered (regain Constitution modifier HP)., 5:The next rest counts as sheltered, and removes one level of Exhaustion., 9:The next rest regains HP as for two nights' rest, and removes one level of Exhaustion., 13:The next rest regains HP as for two nights' rest and removes all Exhaustion., 17:One hour of sleep counts as a full rest; it regains HP as for two nights' rest and removes all Exhaustion.}

activities.name: Beast Tongue
activities.text: {1:Speak with animals for an hour., 5:Speak with animals for an hour; animals start friendly towards the drinker., 9:Speak with friendly animals for an hour, and call a local beast of Level up to half your Witch level to help for an hour., 13:Speak with friendly animals; call a local beast of Level up to two-thirds your Witch level to help for an hour., 17:Speak with friendly animals; call a beast up to your Witch level, or a swarm of lesser beasts, to help for a day.}
